title: Reading Drill — Improving a Community Translation Service
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Improving a Community Translation Service
passages.body:
**A** A public advice service allowed visitors to ask for an interpreter. Front-desk staff initially recorded each request using a single language field, even when visitors spoke two languages.

**B** A worker added fields for first preference and acceptable alternative. The change helped during urgent appointments, when an interpreter for the second language might arrive sooner.

**C** Some visitors also asked for written material in a different language from the conversation. The service began treating that preference as separate and updated its appointment form accordingly.
